sentiment.summary: Friday's tape closed broadly red: hot PPI + spiking 10y yields broke the AI rally, oil surged 11% on the week as the Strait of Hormuz stayed effectively closed, and US futures point to caution heading into Google I/O Tuesday.

insights.text: AI rally cracked on yields + oil shock. 10y yields ripped to 4.55% (highest in a year), VIX +6.8% to 18.43, WTI crude $105.42 on Iran/Hormuz fears. Chips led the unwind. Watch Tuesday's Google I/O for AI sentiment reset.

Navitas ~2x your $10 cost — partnerships accelerating. Cyient Semiconductors deal launches India's first GaN power IC family (stock +21% intraday). Q1 revenue +18% sequential, Q2 guide +16% more. Strategic Navitas 2.0 pivot to high-power GaN/SiC is working.

Rocket Lab still 2x your $62 cost after $133 ATH. Q1 record $200M revenue, $2.2B backlog (doubled YoY), 31 launch contracts in Q1 alone, Morgan Stanley upgrade to $105 PT. Buying Motiv Space Systems. Yield-driven pullback is buyable.

T1 Energy at ~$6.04 — just below your $6.73 cost. Record Q1: $177M revenue, $3.9M net income, $9.1M Adj EBITDA. G2_Austin solar fab on track for Q4 2026 cell production. $160M convertibles fund dilution offset by execution. Hold — fab milestone is the catalyst.

Seagate at ~$710 — 58% above your $449 cost, +147% YTD. Q3 revenue $3.1B (+44% YoY), EPS $4.10 beat. Nearline HDD capacity sold out through 2027, datacenters = 80% of revenue. Evercore $1,000 PT. Trail a stop — let winners run.

Alphabet near your $390 cost — Google I/O Tuesday is the catalyst. Gemini 750M MAU, $4.8T market cap, 2026 capex $180–190B. Gemini 3.5/4.0 reveal + Googlebook launch fuel sentiment reset. Accumulate into I/O.

Micron near $747 — basically at your $791 cost after +180% YTD run. HBM sold out through 2026, Q2 revenue +196% YoY, gross margin 74.9%. Friday -6.6% on yield shock. Memory supercycle is structural — hold through volatility.

Microsoft at ~$420 — above your $410 cost basis. Q3 Azure +40% constant currency, AI run-rate $37B (+123% YoY), 20M Copilot seats. 2026 capex $190B. Defensive compounder with $525+ analyst targets. Hold core position.

SanDisk ~$1,381 — still below your $1,551 cost, but +482% YTD. Q4 guide: 79–81% gross margin, $7.7–8.2B revenue. Nearly sold out for 2026, long-term contracts locked in. NAND cycle risk lurks — monitor closely, but momentum is intact.

Nebius your top winner — +60%+ above your $131 cost. Q1 revenue +684% YoY, AI cloud ARR $1.9B (+674%). Nvidia $2B investment, Meta + Microsoft multi-year deals, Eigen AI $643M acquisition. 3.5GW capacity, targeting 4GW. Hold or trim into strength.

EchoStar ~$135 — 18% above your $114 cost. FCC approved the $40B spectrum sale to AT&T ($23B) + SpaceX ($17B). Initial closes by end of June. Stock +10% past week. Trim into strength — catalyst priced in.

BigBear.ai ~$4.38 — still down 51% from your $9.02 cost. Q1 narrowed EPS loss, $75M new wins, 17% 2026 revenue guide. Defense-AI story building but 87% federal-dependent. Size accordingly — small position, asymmetric outcome.

Oklo ~$69 — 45% below your $125 cost. NRC approved Aurora PDC in record time (15 days vs 30–60 normal). 14GW pipeline (Switch 12GW, Equinix 500MW + $25M prepay). Zero revenue until 2027. Speculative hold only — multi-year story.

Bitcoin ~$78,180 — 7% above your $73,135 cost. -1.1% on the day, consolidating after the Friday risk-off. Macro yield spike pressuring risk assets. 2% allocation — fine to hold as portfolio hedge against fiat debasement.
